doc.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024

title: Ingrid Jensen's low register
summary: She praises her sister Ingrid's warm low trumpet sound and advises long tones at the bottom of the horn.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Cornet or trumpet: choosing and owning horns

blocks.x: Yeah. You and your sister play well together and I think it was on that particular tune I noticed what a wonderful sound that she has down low on her —

Yeah, she’s really good at low. Better than any trumpet player I’ve ever heard. And she — you know that’s again, going back to collecting your tools, I think that’s one she’s used to her advantage. And she used to play flugelhorn but now she has a trumpet that she’s able to mask that flugelhorn sound and get low and warm and in tune and it sounds nearly like it’s an extension of the horn. But I know how she got there actually so if any
kid ever wants to know I’ll tell them, sit down an hour a day and do long tones at the bottom.
